method: GitHub API age/stars/forks check on robbin/wechat-exporter (created 2026-07-28); issue-tracker sweep of WeFlow (13.5k stars, 229 forks, 71 open issues) and WeChatMsg (41.9k stars, 5,270 forks) for first-hand quotes; web search for user complaints about WeChat backup loss.
gap: Everything that exists is either a CLI/skill only a developer can run, or a one-shot 'year in review' poster — nobody has built the durable, ask-anything archive on top of the corpus.

zh.pain: 把整段人生放在微信里的人：十年家庭群、爸妈的语音——而且已经因为换过一次手机丢掉过一部分。
zh.kill: WeChatMsg 从 2023 年做到今天 41.9k 星，随时可能有人正规化补位；客户端一更新解密就失效（WeFlow 用户此刻就卡在过期版本上），平台也没有让它稳定的动机。
zh.move: 不要在导出上竞争，从导出之后切进去，只做一件窄事：挑一段家人的对话，本地问答＋印成一本纪念册。冷启动（中文）：去 WeFlow / WeChatMsg 的 issue 区和 fork 名单，私信那些在喊求 Mac 版、求没过期的安装包的人，再去小红书搜「微信聊天记录 导出」的求助帖评论区。冷启动（英文）：r/DataHoarder 与 r/China_irl 搜 WeChat export。

pain: Anyone whose whole life is in WeChat — a decade of family group chats, a parent's voice notes — and who has already lost a chunk of it to one phone change.
kill: WeChatMsg has been at this since 2023 with 41.9k stars, so a well-funded incumbent could appear; decryption breaks whenever the desktop client updates (WeFlow's own users are currently stuck on an expired build), and the platform has no incentive to make this stable.
move: Don't compete on exporting — start after the export, with one narrow job: pick a single family conversation, answer questions about it locally, and print it as a keepsake book. Cold start (Chinese): message the people in the WeFlow and WeChatMsg issue trackers and fork lists who are asking for a Mac build or an unexpired binary, then the comment sections of Xiaohongshu posts searched for 微信聊天记录 导出. Cold start (English): r/DataHoarder and r/China_irl, search 'WeChat export'. 补(2026-08-07)：keepsake book 这一半不再是假设，需求侧已被两种独立行为证明。中文侧——《45w人看过的聊天记录图册教程》3,692赞/3,013收藏，教的是把聊天记录逐条截图、导进 InDesign 手工排版再送印刷店；同族还有《三年聊天记录，做成了3700多页的电子书》367赞、《打印微信聊天记录长图步骤》226赞。教程排在产品前面、且教的是纯手工流程——与 #577 体检报告那条同一形状。英文侧——一位美国用户把家庭群聊印成传家宝的视频转到小红书拿到 855 赞，评论来自美英两地。结论：改动优先级——先做「导出后 → 一本可印的书」这一段，而不是先做 ask-anything 归档；书是今天就有人在手工做、并愿意跑印刷店的那个成品。
